criteria.name: Threshold diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if December is identified but the threshold status is missing or wrong.

criteria.name: December ledger
criteria.description: Computes the December ledger: 20 heat-threshold days, dry fraction 0.935, 3 wind-threshold days, 2 hot-windy days, 0.4 mm precipitation, and 46.0 C peak temperature.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each major group of correct values: heat, dryness/precipitation, wind/overlap, and peak temperature.

criteria.name: Formula application
criteria.description: Applies the diagnostic formula and reports I=79.6 for 2019-12.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a correct setup with minor rounding or arithmetic errors.

criteria.name: January margin
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the comparison is directionally correct but numerically imprecise.

criteria.name: November margin
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the comparison is directionally correct but numerically imprecise.

criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.description: Keeps the explanation tied to the computed weather index, monthly margins, and stated comparison window.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the explanation is broadly right but the numeric comparison window is weak.
